blocks.text: – The students *should* obey their teachers. – The students *are supposed to* obey their teachers. – The citizens *should* obey the law. – The citizens *are supposed to* obey the law.

items.q: Children should be in bed early.
items.a: They are supposed to be in bed early.

items.q: Drivers should be careful while driving.
Teachers should be on time to class everyday.
Everybody should keep the city clean.
The nurse should know how to give first aid in case of an accident.
Christians should know that they have to go to church.
Smokers should throw the ash of their cigarettes in the ashtray.

items: *The employee:* Good morning. May I help you?
*The man:* Yes, thank you. My name is Karl James. I have a reservation to go to Ottawa – Canada tomorrow morning.
*The employee:* All right. Let me check it …
*The employee:* I’m sorry Mr. Jones, but I don’t have that reservation.
*The man:* I’m not Mr. Jones. I’m Mr. James.
*The employee:* How do you spell it?
*The man:* J-A-M-E-S. It is *supposed to* be checked with care.
*The employee:* Let’s check again… Yes, you were right!
*The employee:* Here you are. Could you repeat every number?
*The man:* I’ll repeat V5X2Y3. Is it confirmed?
*The man:* Bye. Don’t forget you *should be careful* next time!
